goal: Container-host the deepseek-harness for local e2e/benchmark execution: a pinned dsh image with the dal runtime and bwrap/Landlock chain, and a --runner docker seam on verify run and propose run that re-executes the same fail-closed paths inside the container without touching the host's dsh state.

acceptance_criteria.statement: deploy/docker/Dockerfile pins dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 + pnpm 11.7.0 on node:24-slim with bubblewrap and the linux-built dal runtime; the image builds and its digest is recorded.
verify run and propose run accept --runner local|docker; the docker runner hardcodes --network none, mounts only the workspace, translates workspace paths, and passes only policy-listed env names.
An unreachable daemon fails with DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE and paths escaping the mount fail with DOCKER_PATH_DENIED; the in-container verifier re-validates the guardrail at the operation.
The live in-container probe passes the deterministic grader through the Linux sandbox chain (landlock-run, enforcement full) and denies an out-of-roots write in the backend's dialect.
The full local gate passes with the new seam.

outcome.summary: Container-hosted harness execution shipped and live-probed: image sha256:9e3cb523…, landlock-run enforcement full in-container, denial case rejected, gate green, host dsh state untouched.

what_worked: Re-executing the same dal CLI inside the container keeps one guardrail/sandbox code path: the host verifies the decision, the container re-verifies at the operation.
The Linux chain was proven live: the deterministic grader passed under landlock-run with full enforcement, and the outside-root write was denied in the in-container dialect.
Two Dockerfile iterations (corepack/pnpm collision; ENTRYPOINT swallowing commands) were resolved from first-run evidence; the probe tests now catch both.

calls.name: implement-seam
calls.purpose: Add src/docker.ts, executor/propose docker runners, CLI --runner options, and policy docker_image/run_flags/env_names fields.

calls.name: image-build
calls.purpose: Build the pinned harness image with the linux dal runtime and bubblewrap.

calls.name: live-probe
calls.purpose: Run the in-container sandbox probes against the live docker daemon.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Pinned image built and probe-verified: sha256:9e3cb523c1f90a44e49dcb49e60f84764cf4b5c113c210e0e97534dfa63b35ea (recorded in deploy/docker/README.md).
Live in-container probe: deterministic grader passed with sandbox.backend landlock-run, enforcement full; the out-of-roots write was denied in the backend dialect.
Six tests: path translation and escape refusal, command rewriting, argv isolation flags, unavailable-daemon fail-closed behavior, and the two live probes (DAL_DOCKER_PROBE-gated).
Typecheck, build, 128 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: propose run --runner docker was not executed live because the container needs the model credential passed via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; the headless-in-container path shares the verified docker seam.
uncertainty.resolution: Run one propose run --runner docker with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set under the usual send_data_externally approval when a paid model call is next approved.

notes: No host dsh profile, ~/.dsh, or ~/.agents change was made; container execution is a local deterministic path plus the existing send_data_externally approval for model calls.
